renderNote: Rated on the r10/r10v/r10p/r10st renders of HEAD 8efb375-era ceiling code (renders 16:47 UTC). The working tree holds uncommitted 07b/08 edits (crest groove moved to x 0.724 and widened to 18 mm; barSoffit closure over the outboard bin-top ends at door 3). Those edits are not in these renders and were not rated. Lighting snapshots 1582aaa/f5ef1e2 landed between r9 and r10. They lifted the under-bin strip, and the vault fore-aft streaks remain.

fixed: w8a: outboard PSU band shingle pinstripes (soft self-lit steps since w8)
w8a: outboard latch proportion (~2:1 with a handle)
w8a: door-3 soffit speaker no longer a black hole (#4a4441 grille, lighter rim)
w8a/w9b: centre crest-rail joint caps. Visible now in v12 as a raised same-tone cap with a gap line each side (55 mm / 7 mm)
w9a: vault speaker slat pattern gone (the face is smooth)
notFixed: w9a/w9b: door-3 white arcs between the dark tray and the outboard bin-top / cove ends. v3 r10 is pixel-identical to r9 at (290,75) and (680,85). An uncommitted fix is in the working tree.
w9a: dark crest-rail-to-vault groove. In v12 the vault (L 160) meets the rail (L 245) with no dark channel; the 14 mm groove at x 0.712 sits under the rail. An uncommitted fix is in the working tree.
w9a/w9b: row-placard pictograms. They are now side-view seat strokes, but they read as three inverted Ys ('35 ⅄⅄⅄'), not c120's '17 [letter panel][person]'.
w8a/w9b: vault speaker reads faint. It is a pale flat rounded bar with no recess shadow or crescent (v2, v6, v8). The c120 fitting has a crisp raised rim and a shadowed recess.
w8a/w9a/w9b: vault fore-aft streaks / plateaus (lighting/AO, still in v1/v2)
w8a/w9a: door 1/2/4/5 cross-aisle ceilings still unverifiable (q01 camera is still between two monument walls)
partiallyFixed: w9a medium (lighting): the dark strip under the outboard bins went from L 79-107 (r9 v4) to L 147-166 (r10 v4) against the band at 217. It is now a mid-grey line close to y_47301, so it no longer counts as a regression.

details.detail: Aisle vault panels, joint ribs + crest rib
Centre bins (doors, crest rail, caps, groove, PSU channel)
Outboard PSU band (shingles, housings, sign windows)
Door-3 dark soffit (tray, downlights, louvre, speaker)

issues.detail: Crest-rail to vault groove still invisible
issues.problem: c120 shows a dark metallic channel about 1/3 of the rail height, with a specular line, between the centre-bin top rail and the vault. In r10 v12 the rail (L 245) butts straight onto the grey vault (L 160) with no dark line.
issues.fix: 08_bins.js centerBinModule: the groove must lie outboard of the rail's top edge, where it can be seen from the aisle. The uncommitted change (gBox 0.018 at x 0.724, y 2.258) goes that way. Verify in a v12 re-render; if it is still hidden, tilt it to the rail's top tangent (faceM at faceAtY(CBIN_DOOR, 2.245)) and use crestGroove #6e7074.

issues.detail: Door-3 white arcs beside the dark tray (4th report)
issues.problem: Curved white surfaces still frame the tray's upper corners. c133/c134 show the dark soffit running flat to the bin ends and the monuments.
issues.evidence: r10v/v3 (290,75) and (680,85) are identical to r9v/v3
issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js: commit the working-tree barSoffit closure over x 1.62-2.35, y 2.22-2.62 at the zone ends next to door 3, then re-render v3. If an arc remains, it is the DOME sweep end (eFn vault) of the neighbouring zone: extend the barSoffit closure poly to the full DOME profile.

issues.problem: Three side-view seat strokes read as inverted Ys ('35 ⅄⅄⅄'). c120 shows the row number, then one boxed seat-letter panel, then one standing-person icon. y22 shows '32' + a person + a letter box.
issues.fix: 08_bins.js paintBinDecals: replace the seatIcon loop with a 14x16 px rounded outline box containing the seat letter(s) (e.g. 'A', 'DEFG' condensed, or 'K') plus a person glyph (6 px head disc, 7x8 px rounded body), ink #3a3f47, stroke ~2.5 px.

issues.detail: Vault speaker has no edge definition
issues.problem: The fitting reads as a pale flat bar, slightly lighter than the vault, with a soft outline (v6 at 530,255; v8 at 620,70; v1 at 360,255). In c120 it is a raised rounded-rect rim with a recessed face: a crisp dark shadow line inside the rim on the side away from the cove and a light rim edge on the cove side.
issues.evidence: r10v/v1, v6, v8 vs c120 vault crop
issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js: add a 4-6 mm dark inner-shadow ring (#a9a6a1, before the falloff bake) between the bezel and bezelIn on the half away from the grille, or set bezelIn to ~0.90x the bezel tone and its depth to 6 mm so the rim casts. Keep the outer ring in vault tone.

issues.detail: Bin door seams and PSU shingle joints vanish at QA distance
issues.problem: In the official y_47301 the outboard door seams are dark arcs and the band joints are a clear comb of darker lines. In q16 both are almost invisible, so the run reads as one smooth white tube over a plain band. This is an over-correction of w8 (which was judged in close-ups).
issues.fix: 08_bins.js: give doorSeam a 2-3 mm dark core (#9ea2a8) inside the existing light bead. Make the shingle riser a touch darker than the band (e 0.0 on the riser face, or c x0.93) so it survives at 10+ m while staying soft in close-ups.

issues.problem: Plateaus and streaks are still visible along the vault in v1, v2 and v6.
issues.fix: 04_shaders/12_scene (lighting team): smooth the AO-volume lookup in x over y 2.2-2.7.
